title: Capital Flows — X Money · Digital Credit ↔ Margin
notes: v43: Replace planned TREAD card with Panamerica Auto income card (#1133), wired to YNAB category Income > Panamerica Auto and drawn into X Money. TREAD had no flows or history; removed from live views (#64 untouched). v42: Drop JR-strcUSX card from Liquidity Engine (owner/Nakatoshi 2026-10-10). Spine returns to X Money → Digital Credit → Margin. v41: Drop Lyft → Digital Credit. Lyft card is Lyft / GrubHub and lands X Money only (owner 2026-09-11). v40 history: JR-strcUSX was briefly at the bottom of LE, bidirectional with Margin; removed in v42. Turo → X Money only. X Money still funds Deploy and still two-way with Digital Credit (cash ↔ Morpho/BTC).

channels.label: X Money
channels.subtitle: ~6% · ops float
channels.notes: Ops cash sleeve (left of LE). Receives Turo + Lyft / GrubHub + Panamerica Auto; funds Deploy; two-way with Digital Credit (cash ↔ Morpho/BTC).

channels.label: Digital Credit
channels.subtitle: BTC · Morpho · HY
channels.notes: Morpho engine mid-LE: liquidity → BTC spot; LTV cool → HY LTV Buffer; LTV hot → HY tops BTC. One Card refinance via Morpho. Two-way with X Money and with Margin. HY is generic high-yield defense (venue product incidental).

channels.label: Margin
channels.subtitle: Agentic · stocks · HY
channels.notes: RH equities engine: liquidity → stock spot; margin cool → HY LTV Buffer; heat → HY tops stock. Bidirectional with Digital Credit (not X Money). Optional extract is not income. HY is generic high-yield defense (venue product incidental).

channels.label: Collateral
channels.subtitle: Agentic · BTC stack
channels.notes: Deploy sink for free dollars into investable collateral (Agentic / BTC) after Essential + Fleet, before discretionary.
